IMPLEMENTATION CONSIDERATIONS

Decisions that
shape delivery.

01Roles & permissions
Identify who can view, create, approve, and change records. Permission boundaries should reflect the real operating process.
02Data & integrations
Define authoritative systems, APIs, identifiers, migration needs, and synchronization behavior before building dependent workflows.
03Acceptance & adoption
Use representative tasks, user reviews, and documented acceptance scenarios. Training and handover should fit the people operating the application.
